map.name: fortress-quad
map.description: Four identical corner fortresses, rotated 90 degrees: the map edges close two sides of each base; two owned, destructible wall lines close the others, each with one allied-only door. Each base has 1,200 mineral inside and 2,800 at flank expansions outside. Shared deposits lie between corners and in the center.

order.code: const es=self.nearbyEnemies().filter(e=>!e.ruin); const threats=es.filter(e=>!e.isBuilding&&e.atk>0).sort((a,b)=>self.distanceTo(a)-self.distanceTo(b)); const close=threats.find(e=>self.distanceTo(e)<=3); const targets=es.filter(e=>self.distanceTo(e)<=self.range).sort((a,b)=>(a.isBuilding?1000:0)-(b.isBuilding?1000:0)+a.hp-b.hp); if(close){self.suspendOrder();self.flee(close);} else if(targets.length){self.suspendOrder();self.attack(targets[0]);} else if(self.order){self.continueOrder();} else self.hold();
